502715.name: Santovka
502715.note: The website keeps only a 2022 voter-information notice (10.6.2022) and 2026 elections pages; no 2022 announcement of obvody/seats found, and the Internet Archive has no relevant 2022 captures. Web searches found nothing.

503363.name: Maňa
503363.note: The archived 2022 notice-board page lists 'Oznámenie o utvorení obvodov a počte poslancov' (data/editor/183sk_4.pdf), but the old site is gone (404) and the Internet Archive has not captured that PDF nor the okrsky PDF. The current website shows only the 2026 documents.

504998.name: Topoľčany
504998.note: A search engine still indexes the city's page 'Voľby do orgánov samosprávy obcí a samosprávnych krajov 2022' (topolcany.sk/volby-do-organov-samospravy-obci-a-samospravnych-krajov-2022.html) with the file 'Urcenie-volebnych-obvodov-a-pocet-poslancov-v-nich.pdf' dated 30.6.2022, but the page now answers 404 and neither it nor the PDF is in the Internet Archive (none of the ~150 archived 2022 download_file_f.php files is it; volebne-obvody.html is archived only on 21.12.2022 with its content blocked by the cookie banner). Council sessions since 2021 are only on topolcany.digitalnemesto.sk (not the city's domain). No 2022 document with the obvody's streets was found.

506125.name: Kočovce
506125.note: The 2022 elections page (archived 2022-09-07, now 404) links 'OZNAM - určenie VO a poslancov.pdf' (download_file_f.php?id=1708630), which is neither live nor archived. The council page says 9 poslancov elected by parts: Kočovce 3, Beckovská Vieska 3, Rakoľuby 3, without obvod numbers (page from 2014, updated 2023).

508101.name: Modra
508101.note: The 2022 elections page of the old (vismo) website, archived 2022-08-31, links "Oznámenie o utvorení volebných obvodov a určení počtu poslancov.pdf" (id_dokumenty=10758) and "Okrsky a volebné miestnosti Modra" (10765), but neither file was archived and the old site is gone (404/redirect). The new website lists council minutes only from December 2022 and only the 2026 obvody resolution. Web searches found no other 2022 copy.

509345.name: Oščadnica
509345.note: The 2022 resolution (uznesenie OZ č. 18/2022 zo dňa 29.06.2022) names the obvody only: 01 Rovne – 2 poslanci, 02 Vyšný koniec – 2, 03 Centrum – 4, 04 Nižný koniec – 5 (seats match ŠÚ SR); the minutes of 29.06.2022 say the council kept 'the number of councillors and the obvody as in the previous term'. No 2022 document defines their territory: the okrsky notice of 3.8.2022 only names polling rooms. The only territorial definition on the website is the 2018 announcement (obvody by hamlets/osady such as Vreščovka, Peňáci, Košariská, …), which is a 2018 document and in any case not mappable to the register (one part, all 2063 addresses without a street, súpisné numbers only).

509400.name: Raková
509400.note: The June 2022 council resolution defines the 4 obvody by hamlet (osada) names only. Every address in the register has a súpisné number and no street, and the register does not say which hamlet an address is in, so the hamlets cannot be mapped to addresses. No 2022 okrsky document with súpisné numbers exists in the Internet Archive's 2022 captures of rakova.sk. The only okrsky document found (dated 9 Nov 2022, for the referendum of 21 Jan 2023) also lists hamlet names only. The rakova.sk notice found for 2022 is about the Žilina self-governing region (ŽSK) obvody, not the council's obvody.

509451.name: Skalité
509451.note: 2022 document found (Oznámenie of 6.7.2022, uznesenie č. 50/2022 of 14.06.2022: 13 seats, obvod 1 = 6, obvod 2 = 7), but it defines the obvody by settlements/hamlets (Bulavovka, Čanecký potok, U Cecha, Kudlov, … / Bory, Fabrika – Grunik, Ústredie, Kolonia – Martiniaci, …). The register has no streets or parts for Skalité (all 1624 addresses are súpisné numbers in one part), so these names cannot be mapped to rules without a súpisné-number-to-settlement table.

513601.name: Pružina
513601.note: The 2022 decision exists: Uznesenie OZ Pružina č. 29/2022 of 30.6.2022 (archived https://web.archive.org/web/20220803194840/http://www.pruzina.eu/files/UZNESENIE---30.6.2022.pdf) "schvaľuje na komunálne voľby, ktoré budú 29.10.2022 dva volebné obvody: Pružina a Priedhorie, pomer poslancov 7-2". But Priedhorie is neither a part nor a k.ú. of the register: its houses are numbered by súpisné číslo within the part Pružina (k.ú. Pružina), and the resolution does not say where Briestenné (part/k.ú., 21 addresses) belongs. No 2022 document (okrsky decision or announcement) listing the houses of each obvod was found on pruzina.eu or in the Internet Archive, so the obvody cannot be transcribed as rules without guessing. By location, Priedhorie (OSM hamlet node 49.0013 N, 18.4848 E) is the southern cluster of about 200 addresses of the part Pružina, consistent with 2 of 9 seats, but its boundary with Pružina proper along the valley is not documented.

514268.name: Nováky
514268.note: The 2022 resolution was found (uznesenie MsZ č. 863/2022 zo dňa 21.06.2022, scan read visually), but it defines the obvody only geographically, without streets: 'Volebný obvod č. 1 – južná časť mesta po ul. Pribinovu, t. j. chemická a banícka kolónia – 4 poslanecké mandáty; Volebný obvod č. 2 – časť mesta od ul. Pribinovej, pre stred a severnú časť mesta – 5 poslaneckých mandátov; Volebný obvod č. 3 – od železničnej trate pre západnú časť mesta a časť Horné Lelovce – 2 poslanecké mandáty.' The okrsky determination of 22.08.2022 is likewise geographic (okrsok 1 po Svätoplukovu ulicu, 2 od Svätoplukovej po Pribinovu, 3 od Pribinovej po Lehotskú, 4 severná časť od Lehotskej, 5 západná časť od železničnej trate a Horné Lelovce). No published 2022 street list found, so the assignment of streets (incl. the boundary streets Pribinova and Trenčianska, and which Nováky streets lie west of the railway) would be guesswork. Seats match ŠÚ SR (4/5/2); Horné Lelovce part belongs to obvod 3. A maintainer could map it with a street map.

517429.name: Belá
517429.note: Resolution 48/2022 of 11 July 2022 defines the obvody by okrsky: obvod 1 = okrsky 1 and 2 (Belá), 8 seats; obvod 2 = okrsok 3 (Kubíková), 1 seat; obvod 3 = okrsok 4 (Kamence), 2 seats. Okrsok 4 is the hamlets Nižné and Vyšné Kamence (named in the okrsky notice of Nov 2022 for the 2023 referendum). These hamlets are súpisné-only addresses within the part Belá, and the register does not separate them from the part's other 499 addresses without a street (Bránica, Zlieň, hamlets of okrsok 1). No 2022 document lists their súpisné numbers. So obvod 3 cannot be told apart from obvod 1 without guessing.

517488.name: Divina
517488.note: Resolution 40/2022 of 10 June 2022 and the announcement of 13 June 2022 set the obvody as: 1 Divina – dolná (3 seats), 2 Divina – horná (4 seats), 3 Divina – Lúky (2 seats). Lúky is a part, but dolná and horná both lie in the part Divina, whose addresses are súpisné-only. Neither document draws the line between dolná and horná. The 2022 notice board has no okrsky document. The Nov 2022 okrsky notice for the referendum also says only 'Divina dolná' / 'Divina horná', and the Internet Archive has no 2022 captures of divina.sk. So obvody 1 and 2 cannot be separated.

517674.name: Kolárovice
517674.note: Uznesenie OZ č. 176 of 6 June 2022 (UZNESENIA OZ 6.6.2022.pdf, live) only sets two obvody with 6 and 3 seats, without saying which parts form them. The 2022 elections page (archived 2022-12-04) linked 'Určenie počtu - poslancov volben. obvodov.pdf' (file 37a44e75|360) and 'Utvorenie voleb. okrskov a urče. vol,miestn..pdf' (file 4479ac1d|364), but both are gone from the live site (404) and not in the Internet Archive. The live site shows only 2026 documents. No 2022 document assigning parts (Babiše, Bršlica, Korytné, Slopkov, Čiakov, Škoruby) to the obvody was found.

517917.name: Rajec
517917.note: No 2022 resolution or announcement found: the 2022 elections page holds only results and candidate lists; the old site's 2022 snapshots contain no election documents. The live page 'Volebné obvody a okrsky' (new website, © 2024, undated, no seats) lists streets of 4 obvody/okrsky but is not a document dated for 2022, so it was not used.

518549.name: Kriváň
518549.note: Uznesenie č. 18/9 of 7 July 2022 sets 9 seats in 2 obvody: obvod 1 (Pod traťou) 5 seats, obvod 2 (Nad traťou) 4 seats — named only by side of the railway, with no list of houses; the municipality has no streets (all 717 addresses by súpisné číslo) and no 2022 document assigning houses or okrsky was found. 'Obvody poslancov.pdf' lists the councillors' service areas for 2022–2026 (9 areas), not the electoral obvody. The Internet Archive holds the site only from March 2022.

526657.name: Žehra
526657.note: The 2022 obvody were set not by the council but by 'Rozhodnutie prednostu Okresného úradu Spišská Nová Ves' OU-SN-OVVS-2022/010355-1 of 08.08.2022 (published on obeczehra.sk, Komunálne voľby 2022, 'Oznámenie o určení počtu poslancov a utvorení volebných obvodov'): 9 poslancov; obvod č. 1 'Žehra – centrálna časť a Žehra – časť Hodkovce' 2 poslanci; obvod č. 2 'Žehra – sídlisko Dreveník a osada Dreveník' 7 poslancov. The okrsky announcement of 21.07.2022 (JPG) uses the same descriptions. Seats match ŠÚ SR. Not transcribable: the register's part Žehra (151 addresses, no streets) must be split between the centre (obvod 1) and the Dreveník housing estate/settlement (obvod 2), and neither document gives súpisné numbers or any other boundary; Hodkovce is wholly obvod 1. A transcription would need súpisné numbers of the Dreveník estate and settlement (not published), so no rules were guessed.

543047.name: Klátova Nová Ves
543047.note: The minutes of the council of 30.6.2022 (download_file_f.php?id=1781851) record the 2022 decision: 2 obvody, obvod 1 with 7 seats, obvod 2 with 2 seats — but they do not say which parts form each obvod (no announcement of 2022 found; the Internet Archive has the site only up to March 2022). The live 'Volebne-obvody.pdf' is Uznesenie č. 23/2026 for 2026 (obvod 1 Klátova Nová Ves, obvod 2 Janova Ves), not usable for 2022; it also does not place the part Sádok.

544051.name: Vranov nad Topľou
544051.note: Uznesenie MsZ č. 252/2022 of 30.6.2022 (39. MsZ, in the 2018-2022 ZIP of resolutions) only names the 5 obvody and seats: Lomnica 1, Čemerné 4, Sever 6, Centrum 6, Juh 8 — no streets or okrsky. The 2022 elections page now lists only results; the oznámenie o utvorení volebných obvodov and the 2022 okrsky document were removed after the election, and the Internet Archive has no snapshot of the page between 15.6.2022 and 29.11.2022 nor any of those files. The council material for item 13 of the 39. MsZ is not online. Territory of Sever/Centrum/Juh cannot be transcribed without guessing.
